basic_details.job_title: CSIR IIIM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 16 Project Associate, Project Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine (CSIR-IIIM), Jammu, a CSIR institute under the Department of Scientific & Industrial Research, Ministry of Science & Technology, has invited applications for 16 temporary project positions under the CSIR-funded Project No. MMP-025304, "Driving Sustainable Rural Empowerment and Entrepreneurship through Aromatic Plants (CSIR-Aroma Mission 4.0)". Posts are Senior Project Associate, Project Associate-II, Project Associate-I and Project Assistant-II, with stipend from ₹20,000 to ₹42,000 per month plus HRA. Code 02, Project Associate-II / Project Associate-I: experience in isolation and purification of natural products, or knowledge of analytical techniques, will be preferred. content_sections.heading: About CSIR-IIIM
content_sections.text: CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine is described in the notice as a premier institute working under the aegis of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), an autonomous body under the Department of Scientific & Industrial Research, Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. Its address in the notice is Canal Road, Jammu, Jammu & Kashmir - 180001. The notice is dated 26 November 2026 and is signed by the Controller of Administration.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 16 positions across eight position codes. Position code 02 is printed as "Project Associate-II (01 position) OR Project Associate-I (03 positions)"; the 16 counts both. The notice does not print category-wise vacancies. The number of positions may vary with project requirements at the time of interview. If no suitable candidate is found for the Project Associate-II position, the notice says it may be downgraded to Project Associate-I.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualifications are given for each position code. Age is reckoned as on the last date of submission of application, and relaxation is given as per Government of India Rules. All applicants must meet the essential qualification and other conditions as on that last date. Code 01, Senior Project Associate: experience in animal cell culture, in vitro cell assays, flow cytometry based assays, fluorescence microscopy, column chromatography and FTIR spectroscopy will be preferred. Code 02, Project Associate-II / Project Associate-I: experience in isolation and purification of natural products, or knowledge of analytical techniques, will be preferred. Code 03 and code 04: the notice states that candidates may need to travel extensively across the country to implement project objectives. Code 05: experience in handling small animals or cell culture techniques will be preferred. Code 06: rural extension or agriculture dissemination experience in aromatic plants is listed. Code 07: experience in designing, developing and maintaining responsive websites and web applications, along with database development and API management, will be preferred. Code 08, Project Assistant-II: expertise in operation of distillation units, pelletting machines, briquetting machines and design and development of agricultural equipment will be preferred. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each position.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice calls the pay a stipend, stated per month in rupees. Pay (a) is for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET including Lecturership/Assistant Professorship, or GATE, or national level examinations conducted by Central Government departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their agencies or institutions. Pay (b) is for those who do not fall under (a). HRA will be paid only if institutional accommodation is not availed or provided. Engagement is initially for one year or until the project duration, whichever is earlier, and may be extended or curtailed depending on the project duration, requirements and performance or conduct. The tenure is co-terminus with the project, and the total tenure, including engagement in all CSIR labs, shall not exceed six years. Performance will be reviewed periodically, and unsatisfactory performance may lead to termination without any notice or reason.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is on the basis of an interview. If a large number of candidates apply, the Screening Committee may revisit the screening criteria if required. The interview will be held in hybrid mode (online and offline), and candidates may interact with the Selection Committee in English or Hindi. The notice does not print an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many positions are advertised in CSIR-IIIM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 16 project positions across eight position codes, including 1 Senior Project Associate, 1 Project Associate-II, 11 Project Associate-I and 2 Project Assistant-II, under Advertisement No. 44/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 08 December 2026 (Tuesday), up to 05:00 PM. Forms submitted after that time will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: M.Sc in Biotechnology from a recognized university or equivalent with three years of research experience, or a Doctoral degree in Biotechnology with two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Assistant-II?
faq.answer: The qualification is a Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical or Chemical Engineering. Two positions are advertised under position code 08.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for Senior Project Associate and 35 years for all other posts. Relaxation is as per Government of India Rules, and age is counted as on the last date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for each post?
faq.answer: Senior Project Associate gets ₹42,000 plus HRA. Project Associate-II gets ₹35,000 or ₹28,000, Project Associate-I gets ₹31,000 or ₹25,000, and Project Assistant-II gets ₹20,000, each plus HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Who gets the higher stipend of Project Associate-I and II?
faq.answer: The higher amount, pay (a), is for candidates who qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET (including Lecturership/Assistant Professorship) or GATE, or certain national level examinations conducted by Central Government departments like DBT/DST or their agencies. Others get pay (b).

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: HRA is added to the stipend, but it will be paid only if institutional accommodation is not availed or provided.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of an interview held in hybrid mode (online and offline). If many candidates apply, the Screening Committee may revisit the screening criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and how long is the engagement?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary. Engagement is initially for one year or the project duration, whichever is earlier, and the total tenure, including all CSIR labs, cannot exceed six years.
